Critical Path-Based Iterative Heuristic.title: Critical Path-Based Iterative Heuristic for Workflow Scheduling in Utility and Cloud Computing
Critical Path-Based Iterative Heuristic.venue: Springer Lecture Notes in Computer Science
Critical Path-Based Iterative Heuristic.key_insight: 迭代生成完整关键路径而非部分关键路径，将路径优化松弛为多阶段决策过程(MDP)用动态规划求解
Critical Path-Based Iterative Heuristic.method_signature: CPI启发式：迭代构造完整关键路径，动态规划Pareto方法(DPPM)优化路径

ICPS_ Real-Time Resource Configuration f.title: ICPS: Real-Time Resource Configuration for Cloud Serverless Functions Considering Affinity
ICPS_ Real-Time Resource Configuration f.key_insight: Predict function concurrency via LSTM, pre-warm instances to avoid cold starts, and co-locate dependent functions on same worker node via affinity
ICPS_ Real-Time Resource Configuration f.method_signature: ICPS: LSTM-based concurrency prediction + affinity-based instance deployment + request routing

Iterative Heuristics for Permutation Flo.title: Iterative Heuristics for Permutation Flow Shops with Total Flowtime Minimization
Iterative Heuristics for Permutation Flo.key_insight: 迭代搜索能大幅提升基于RZ插入的启发式性能, 但对NEH插入类启发式提升有限
Iterative Heuristics for Permutation Flo.method_signature: 在迭代RZ框架上集成LR初始解生成和FPE/FPE-R邻域搜索

Pattern learning for scheduling microser.title: Pattern learning for scheduling microservice workflow to cloud containers
Pattern learning for scheduling microser.venue: International Journal of Machine Learning and Cybernetics
Pattern learning for scheduling microser.key_insight: 通过GNN挖掘工作流中的模式子结构,复用排序结果可避免重复计算
Pattern learning for scheduling microser.method_signature: PMWSC框架: GNN模式识别 → 工作流排序 → 任务排序(PB-TS) → 资源选择(PB-RS)
